reviews.text:
I attempted to be a new customer.  I showed up with my dog on-time at 10am  BUT... the clinic apparently prioritizes walk-ins that show up before you.  I was told it would be an hour wait.
I would not have minded the wait if I was informed as a new customer how the clinic works. I would have left enough time

Im glad this place attempts to help as many pets as possible but they didnt help my pet because I had another appt and could not wait.
I spoke to 3 staff people before finally having to leave.  None of them wanted or were capable of understanding why not informing new customers of a possible hour plus wait might be frustrating.  They all were very defensive about how the clinic worked.   Im sorry I did not understand that in advance.  Maybe one day they will start sharing this info with new customers.
Dr. Oh really lives up to his reputation. He is a wonderful doctor that was so kind to my cat and gave me the option to pick which treatment I found nessasary. I can tell he really loves animals
the best veterinary place in the valley, the only place we go for my cat needs.

Extremely rude and unprofessional front desk staff.

I arrived on time for my appointment and waited 30 minutes without any meaningful update. When I politely asked about the delay, I was met with dismissive responses. The receptionist then snatched my dog’s leash, lectured me about “respecting other people’s time,” and told me to “go to another vet next time.”

I will.

Delays happen, but hostile treatment and poor communication are unacceptable. I recommend taking the receptionist’s advice and choosing another clinic.

Extremely rude and disrespectful staff who have no thought or care for others time. I had a scheduled appointment, which I was on time to. After waiting 15 minutes past the appointment time, I asked when the appointment would be, which apparently you’re not allowed to do in this office, as the receptionists gave me dirty looks and rude responses the 2 times I asked. After 30 minutes of waiting, I went to ask again as people have other things planned in the day and I wouldn’t have made the appointment if they had told me when I booked it that it was going to be an over 30 minute wait. At that point, the receptionist snatched my dogs leash from my hand and goes off of a rant about how you have to respect for other people’s times, which was pretty hypocritical coming from her and told me to“ go to another vet next”. Which is what I recommend for you all to do, unless you like being treated like shit, which seems like a common theme at this veterinary clinic as the lady who is in before me also seemed very unhappy with the treatment by the reception staff.

Can’t tell you how the actual doctor is because the front staff was so aggressive that I didn’t even get to ask about the shot my dog got because they just basically forced my appointment and I wasn’t allowed to ask any questions.

I have many pets, all of which have been so well-cared for by Dr. Oh! He provides the absolute best care out of all the many veterinarian offices I've taken my pets over the years. It is very comforting knowing he is a privately owned practice -  I have had awful experiences at private equity vet offices. Unlike them, Dr. Oh makes medical decisions based on what is best for your pet, without trying to bankrupt pet owners. Services are affordable and reasonable. We are incredibly grateful for him and his helpful staff!!!

We had such a great experience! The doctor was incredibly attentive, a great listener, and very thorough. The visit was quick and easy, and he took the time to fully examine my fur baby and prescribe everything necessary.

He also gave us some really helpful suggestions for additional treatments to help manage other diagnoses that weren’t related to the reason we came in, which I really appreciated. You can tell he genuinely cares about the animals and their overall well-being.

My fur baby is already feeling happier and healthier!  The staff were kind, helpful, and welcoming, and the overall atmosphere was wonderful. I’ve honestly never had a better experience at a vet. Highly recommend!

I’ve been bringing my child (ie. Senior kitty) to Dr. Oh for mainly lab work and semi-urgent care visits the past 7 or so months. I’m a fairly new mom, took over ownership in Dec 2022 and finding good reliable and capable practices that are truly animal first has been a huge and often disappointing challenge. When I first got her she was on no medications and now she’s on 5, in addition to Dr. Oh my baby also has a feline specific internist and feline specific primary doctor. The technicians are extremely efficient and the prices are the best I’ve seen anywhere. After 1 or 2 visits, I called the office and Dr. Oh picked up and immediately said: how’s Lucy? And you know something? I feel like he really cared. Reasonable prices and care?  And on top of that the facility is clean and the front desk staff and techs are professional, capable, accommodating  and a well oiled machine. Thank you, Dr. Oh. You are a gem of a vet and I’m so incredibly grateful to have been referred to you and your well oiled, community/pet first practice that you have clearly built with integrity and care.

Dr. Ho is straightforward and treats customers well, which is why I've been visiting his clinic. However, his employees (Especially Rick) need more training on handling customers requesting pet accommodations. If a procedure is required, the employee should explain it clearly. If the customer is unresponsive and asks for a supervisor, one should be called immediately. I hope Dr. Ho reviews this feedback and establishes procedures for handling mandatory requests.
Caring Staff and very reasonable. I Truly believe they all care Greatly my kitty. Thank You Dr. Oh !!!

BEWARE !!!Poor service and horrible doctors. I saw other similar reviews and sadly, they’re true. I paid to get my dog checked up and two weeks later my dog gets diagnosed with cancer at another vet. Crazy. How could they miss something like this so bad and now my dog’s cancer is extremely severe. PLEASE STAY AWAY
The vet and entire staff are so kind and caring and their fees are very reasonable

Always a pleasure I’ve been coming here since I was a teenager many years ago and continue to come here because the quality of care that is delivered has always made coming to the vet something easy rather than difficult, and I can honestly say the Doctor really has a passion for what he does and I have never been turned away, even with two of my reactive pets. He always make sure that no animal goes untreated so they can live the best quality of life and that’s something so admirable that you don’t really see anymore. 1,000 stars if I could honestly.

I do not recommend this clinic if your pet is sick or has an ongoing medical condition.

‼️⚠️You pay for an exam, but Dr. Oh doesn’t even take the time to properly examine your pet. They don’t explain things clearly, don’t seem interested in your pet’s medical history, and don’t perform a thorough physical exam. They didn’t even check my dog’s temperature.
* They also do not respect appointment times. I had to wait over 30 minutes, and the wait was much longer than the actual examination.⚠️‼️

I took my dog to this clinic twice. During the first visit, they performed blood and fecal tests, gave my dog an injection, and prescribed medication. When there was no improvement, I returned the following week. They prescribed the same medication again, but my dog never got better. In fact, her condition stayed the same or became worse.

Dr. Oh kept telling me she would be fine, but they never figured out how to properly treat her condition. Instead of referring me to a more experienced specialist when the treatment clearly wasn’t working, they continued treating her with an ineffective approach. As a result, I wasted both my time and my money while my dog continued to suffer.

Dr. Oh has been seeing my service dog for the past 3 years. He is great with his medication management after two back to back upper respiratory problems (we took him to an ER and the med combo was not ideal for his breed and did not help solve his issue but Dr. Oh did amazing with the medicine combo)

Recently we introduced our 4 cats to their team and they were very welcoming and attentive as 2 of my cats are not well socialized (one feral born and the other is a nursery baby I raised)

Yesterday we made an appointment because our youngest cat urinated some blood and Dr Oh and the team LITERALLY save his life and performed an emergency surgery. I was working yesterday and sent my not extremely animal savvy boyfriend and Dr OH and the vet shadowing him were real nice, helpful and answered all my boyfriend question so he could be at ease while the procedure was done.

The RVT/Nurse assistant that was delivering the estimate was quite rude and rushed my boyfriend while he was making decisions and phone calls to confirm the time off work, check with me about my opinion on the procedure and letting his family know. He really needs a talk about being more kind and patient while a 3000 dollar decision and a life or dead decision is being made, like I said Dr oh and the vet shadowing him AMAZING professionally, this nurse/Rvt/assistent was awful, rush and unkind.

I will not reduce my 5 star review of the clinic for an unprofessional rvt when the head of clinic, the reception and most of the team is amazing but I wanted to voice my opinion so he gets the training he needs to work in an industry so delicate as animal well fare. And this coming from a former shelter worker and a boarding/daycare facility manager

My cat Toto is recovering awesome at home and I attached a picture of the massive bladder stone they removed from him. THANK YOU DR OH and most of your incredible team.

One of my cats went to the rainbow bridge today and the staff was amazing and the prices affordable.

Update: I received a condolences card and the whole office signed it. I also brought one of my other furbabies in and the procedure she needs is a really good price and since my last visit ( if you have good credit) you can make payments on your vet bills. Which is extremely helpful for me. ❤️
Good experience and pricing is enticing especially, with most vets charging so much for services most people can’t afford. I recommend for services and treatments for your dogs and felines.
This is the best vet we’ve ever gone to! They are kind, knowledgeable, and fairly priced. They gave my dog the best care, and I’m just so grateful. This will absolutely be our vet moving forward!
Great service, the very  important is good attitude and attention to the costumers.

I had a very disappointing experience at Van Nuys Clinic, and unfortunately, I will never be returning.

First, we spent an extremely long time waiting in the exam room. Different staff members kept coming in and out, but nothing was actually getting done.

When Dr. Oh finally came in, the examination lasted only a few seconds. He briefly looked at my kittens and immediately rushed them back into their carriers. He was in such a hurry that he didn't even give me the opportunity to explain my kittens' symptoms and behavior so he could fully understand what was going on. Every question I asked was answered quickly and carelessly, and I felt like he was trying to end the appointment as fast as possible.

The staff member who trimmed my kittens' nails seemed very inexperienced, almost as if it was her first day on the job. We were charged $20 per kitten for nail trimming, yet the job wasn't even done properly.

The only positive part of my experience was Cassandra. She was patient, kind, and took the time to answer all of my questions. As a first-time pet owner, I truly appreciated that she listened, explained everything clearly, and never made me feel rushed. Thank you, Cassandra—you were the only reason this visit had any positive aspect.

On top of everything, we were charged a significant amount of money without receiving the level of care we expected. After all the tests and vaccinations, they failed to properly document everything in my kittens' vaccination booklets. There were missing records and stickers, which forced me to drive all the way back on another day to fix their mistake.

What made it even worse was that the receptionist who handled my case never apologized. Instead, she was rude and dismissive. Even after I returned, they made another mistake by placing a vaccine sticker in the booklet of a kitten that had never received that vaccine.

The level of disorganization, carelessness, and lack of respect for clients' time was shocking. Cassandra was the only bright spot in an otherwise terrible experience, and I sincerely thank her for her professionalism and kindness. As for the clinic itself, I cannot recommend it and will never return
👎👎👎👎

I can’t recommend Van Nuys Vet Clinic enough! From the moment I called, the entire team was incredibly kind and compassionate. The girls at the front desk went above and beyond by squeezing my little guy in at the very end of the day on one of their busiest days before the Fourth of July holiday. I know they were extremely busy, but they still made time for us, and I’m so grateful.

My little pup decided to do some “parkour” off the furniture after the midweek fireworks scared him, and he suddenly became completely non-weight-bearing on his back leg.Dr. Oh was absolutely amazing. He wasted no time getting X-rays, quickly diagnosed a hairline fracture, and thoroughly explained everything to me. Thankfully, surgery wasn’t necessary, and we have a treatment plan to help him heal.

Every single person we encountered showed genuine care, kindness, and compassion not just for my dog, but for me as a worried pet parent. The clinic itself is adorable too! I loved all the cute pet photos decorating the office and wish I had taken more pictures because it has such a welcoming atmosphere.

Thank you, Dr. Oh and the entire Van Nuys Vet Clinic team, for taking such great care of my little guy. We truly appreciate everything you did and couldn’t have asked for a better experience during such a stressful day. ❤️🐾

Ok just 2 concerns. If you have an appointment remember you will be waiting 1h -1.5h extra just to be seen. 2: they will try to sell everything to you, make sure you review the documents and cross off the extra stuff. This will save you hundreds.
The front desk reception wearing all black with black hair on 7/1 at 11am is incredibly rude. You should have a word with that sassy girl.

Appointment was at 1230 and I wasn’t seen until 130. Staff didn’t communicate with me about the wait until I asked around 120. Doctor was nice but was in and out in 2 minutes and tech handled the rest. Seeing the doc is an extra 30 dollars, which makes no sense. There’s also no public restroom…

My previous vet did not like animals, nor did he really like people. He was rude, unpleasant, and hardly interacted with my boy. Now that he has passed my only regret was never taking him to Dr. Oh. From the first interaction we could tell that Dr. Oh loves people, pets, and most of all, his job. He is so pleasant to talk to and interacts so kindly with my girl! I often have to drive up to 30 minutes to get here but I will never consider taking my girl elsewhere. There have been several instances where he was able to fit me in the exact same day, him and his office are very accomodating! If you want personable, kind, cost-effective service, you won't get anything better from anyone besides Dr. Oh!

⚠️DOG DECEASED⚠️⚠️⚠️ My dog Apollo has been coming here for years I trusted Dr.O just a week ago he got diagnosed with diabetes I told the dr about a trip we had planned to New York for 6 days I asked him twice should we start Apollo’s insulin after we are back so we don’t strip him off of it he said no to start right away and I mentioned TWICE should I cancel my trip he told me Apollo might not feel well but HE WILL NOT DIE EXACT WORDS TWICE I came home last night rushed Apollo to the ER because he didn’t look alright and when we got there Apollo passed away when I called the vet today and told the doctor that he told me Apollo will be fine he won’t die he told me it was a miscommunication … I have evidence that of what he said and now they want to lie my dog is deceased and I am beyond broken if dr had told me there will be even a .1 chance Apollo could die I would have never left NEVER maybe I should have known better but I’m not the licensed professional we are taught that doctors know best so I listened to my LICENSED doctor
Dr. Oh is caring and patient.

Unfortunately my visit did not turn out the way I wanted to. I am very grateful to the staff and this might be my new veterinary clinic. The price was very Reasonable. Office clean with welcoming staff who were attentive.. I’m looking forward to treating my other pets and making sure that they’re vaccinated and healthy.

This is the only vet I take my dogs to. Dr. O is very knowledgeable and attentive to their needs. Have taken them here for foxtail surgery on multiple occasions
. 100% recommend
Called and didn’t even say hi just placed me on hold

Vet is my kittens primary doctor. My old cat had a different vet who gave us no hope for her infection. Brought her in as emergency as our only other option was to put her down or let her die. They let me know they can’t take walk ins at which point my mom asked very kindly if she can at least talk to the doctor to make an exception. She yelled at my mother “I don’t know what you’re not understanding, I already told you we won’t take her” at which point I told my mom we’re leaving it and taking my kitten out of this vet too. Unfortunate how an ugly soul can get hired at a place to care for such innocent creatures. Nasty.

Dr. Oh and his team were incredibly welcoming and kind. My puppy Rocky wasn’t feeling well, but thanks to their attentive care and attention to detail, he’s back to his happy self. I truly appreciate their kindness and professionalism! I even got a follow up call  from Dr. Oh the following day and this shows that they truly care. Highly recommend taking your furry loved ones here.

I have 3 dogs. I love coming here it's more affordable than most places. They are quick and thorough. Dr Oh is super approachable and such a kind individual. I appreciate this so much as an anxious pet parent . He runs a hard working vet team and it doesn't go unseen. His team always gets back in a timely fashion in responding to emails and calls . He's a gem and I will bring every pet  to him and I recommend him to all.

The vet itself is very good but there’s one receptionist who is very rude there. Not sure what her name is but she has pink hair.
When I first walked in I didn’t get a hello welcome or nothing. Waited at the sign for a while without her acknowledging me (it was just me by the way, no other clients). She finally called me and just said “you have an appointment?”. I gave her the name of my pet and appointment time which was at 3:30pm. The whole time she has an attitude and tells me my appointment was at 3pm. I didn’t say anything and pull up the confirmation on my phone and show it to her. Instead of acknowledging and apologizing about the time of the appointment she says “ok but you didn’t have to shove your phone in my face”, I responded that I didn’t shove my phone in your face and she repeated the same thing. Clearly she has never had a phone shoved in her face before or she wouldn’t have said that. I literally showed her over the computer because it was an email with small writing. She’s very unprofessional and rude. Seems like she hates her job. Other than her. It’s a great vet!

I took my 5 year old cat to get her first dental cleaning. My cat doesn't like to be uprooted from the house so I already had a little anxiety. But when I got there I was reassured that she'd be fine. And someone called me to lmk everything went fine, she's awake from the anesthesia, and the time to pick her up. It's a pricey procedure but more affordable compared to other clinics. Dr. Oh and staff did a good job. No more yellow gunk and no more stinky teeth! Will continue to come here for future work.

Dr. Oh's been taking care of my Marley for over 7 years now. They really care about Marley and made us feel so comfortable during our visit. They are always thorough, gentle, and take the time to answer all our questions. The staff and the front desk is also really helpful and kind, making it a welcoming and supportive place. We really appreciate how well Marley is taken care of and would absolutely recommend Dr. Oh to others. We couldn't have asked for a better Veterinarian.
The price is high, but I have always had good experiences there.
Very good clinic, the staff really care about the pet and the family members.  I can’t thank them enough for the service they provided for our pet.

A friend highly recommended this vet. He was very nice and gave me a referral to a dentist for presumed periodontal disease and didn't charge me for the consult. This is refreshing because most vets will charge just to walk in the door. Office was clean and comfortable and he and the staff were personable. My dog is skiddish, but he was patient and made her comfortable during the exam. I gave 4 stars because I felt that he should've prescribed pain medicine for my dog, and possibly antibiotics, seeing that he recommended she see a specialist for teeth removal and bad decay, and since I couldn't see the referred vet for a week.
The best clinic in LA and the kindest and most attentive staff

The best clinic )))

The best doctor we have ever had) good prices and a wonderful attitude toward animals) very attentive and kind staff.
Brought my chihuahua here recently and I have no complaints. All the staff were welcoming and informative.

I took my cat to this vet multiple times for an allergy he has and they never gave me a solution to help him or find out what he had. They always gave him shots and the last time I took him to this vet, they took him to a room for a shot and they were to aggressive with him because I found his nail in his carrier and when i checked him he was missing a nail. When I confronted them the lady’s in the front started laughing. Please be careful with your pets!!!

First time going to Dr. Oh. Prices are very reasonable. Great staff. He has 3 front desk employees and yet i still heard someone not happy because she was waiting 30 minutes. They took her in right away after complaining but she did not complain because she was taken in before myself which i was ahead of her. It is full of pets and we need to take care of our Vets as they are there to protect and heal our pets. Do not be that one greedy person that will make things worse for the rest of us. Prices are affordable and they took me in same day which they didn't have to. Medication is affordable as well. Thank you for being there at my most vulnerable moment, me being a first time furmom your office was so much help for me.
Very satisfied with the service. Dr. Oh was honest, fairly priced, very kind, and understanding of my sadness. His staff was attentive and bilingual.

⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️⛔️⛔️⛔️⛔️⛔️This clinic has a history of making mistakes And MISDIAGNOSIS ! DO NOT COME HERE!!!!!! This is a great office. We've been taking our dog here for years and appreciate the great care we've received from Dr. Oh and his team.

The doctor is one of the most attentive I've ever met. I really like the way he's treated my fur baby 🐕. The staff is friendly, the girls at the front desk are very kind and attentive, some of the technicians are very serious 😅 but he's treated my baby professionally and that's what matters most ❤️

Dr. Oh definitely saved our cat's life!  He is knowledgeable, kind, honest, and patient. He explains everything clearly, and his prices are extremely reasonable. Lots of my neighbors recommend him, and so do I. He is the BEST veterinarian!  He and everyone else there genuinely care about your fur baby.

Our experience with this clinic was deeply concerning and, ultimately, devastating.

Our cat was paraplegic, which alone should have prompted extra care and consideration. He was prescribed Animax ointment without any meaningful discussion of potential side effects, risks, or precautions, particularly regarding gastrointestinal sensitivity. No warnings were provided.

At the time of the appointment, our cat was in excellent condition-alert, energetic, eating well, and stable. The visit itself felt rushed, lacked a holistic approach, and we were left feeling that we were the ones driving the discussion and suggesting what analyses might be appropriate. Importantly, no additional testing or diagnostic work (including blood work or baseline assessments) was recommended or discussed before prescribing the medication.

After the second day of applying Animax, our cat began vomiting. Each subsequent application was followed by further vomiting. We were instructed to apply the ointment twice daily for 10–14 days, which, in hindsight, is alarming given what followed. We discontinued the medication as soon as the pattern became clear, but by that point his stomach appeared severely irritated. He developed escalating lethargy, persistent vomiting, and began refusing food.

When we contacted the clinic afterward, the response was equally troubling. The person who answered the phone insisted-dismissively-that this medication “doesn’t have side effects.” This statement is simply not accurate and raises serious concerns about both knowledge and accountability.

While we are not stating that the medication alone caused what followed, it is undeniable that his decline began immediately after starting this treatment. As pet owners, we trusted this clinic to inform us properly, assess risks, and practice with care. That trust was not met!!!

Licensure alone does not equal competence. There are poor, average, and excellent practitioners in every field, and this experience fell far short of acceptable standards.

Please consider seeking care elsewhere. Ask questions. Demand explanations. Your pet deserves thoughtful, informed, and cautious medical care. Avoid this clinic at all cost.
The best aforable vet I've ever been too
They're very helpful and affordable. The doctor has to move quickly because they are so busy, but he has helped us with many issues.
Unfair pricing - they are not transparent on pricing and price gouge based on how much you might be willing to pay rather than being up front on what services cost what. Front staff office rude
This place is great. Rough on the outside, but amazing care on the inside where it counts.  The fees for services are remarkable compared to most vet offices.  Highly recommend this place.
Excellent service! First time at this clinic, the vaccine prices are very good. Excellent customer service. 100% Recommended!
By far the best veterinarian I taken my pets too. Very professional, friendly and affordable. I will continue to to bring my pets here.

This was my first visit, and I couldn't be happier with the care my cat received from Dr. Oh and his staff. He is knowledgeable and kind, as is his team. The prices were reasonable, and I appreciate their conservative approach to treatment. Even though the waiting room was full, the staff was efficient, and we were in and out within the hour. Highly recommend!

I’ve been going to Van Nuys Veterinary Clinic for many years, and I honestly wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else. Dr. Oh is incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, and thorough, and he always takes the time to explain everything and never rushes you. You can tell he genuinely cares about the animals and their owners. The staff is friendly, the clinic is clean and organized, affordable, and they’ve consistently provided outstanding care through every visit and procedure. After all these years, I can confidently say Dr. Oh is one of the best veterinarians in Los Angeles.
Our go to vet for all our pets. We’ve always been treated with love, care, and respect.

I’ve been raising my Shiba Inu, Huchu, for 5 years, and this animal hospital has been a huge part of our journey.
Five years ago, other clinics told me that my dog’s eye had to be removed. I visited two different hospitals before finding this one.

But when the doctor here examined Huchu, he said the eye could be saved — that Huchu could still see!
He performed a small incision surgery above the eye, and thanks to him, my dog didn’t have to lose his eye.

Since then, we’ve continued to come here for Huchu’s atopic skin issues, which are now almost completely cured.
Even though I live in Thousand Oaks, I still drive all the way here because other clinics never helped the way this one did.

Today, Huchu had blood in his urine, and when I called, they told me to come in right away.
Thankfully, it wasn’t serious — he got an injection and is now recovering well.

The receptionists are always friendly, the nurse who gave the injection was so kind and explained everything clearly,
and the doctor went through the X-rays in detail, comparing images and reassuring me every step of the way.

Every time I come here, I leave feeling grateful and relieved.
Thank you so much to everyone at this hospital — you’ve truly made a difference for us! 🐶❤️

This is the ideal vet.
The pricing is fair. The staff is fast, friendly and caring.
I've been here many times for different pets and they continue to be amazing.
I trust them.
Dr. Oh is family

Honest and affordable, very rare to find both in this industry but VNVC is it! Have nothing but positive things to say about this clinic. I heard good reviews and decided to check out Van Nuys Vet Clinic after being put through the financial ringer and waiting 4 hours with a previous vet only for them to not be able to tell me they didn’t know what was wrong with my cat. Dr. Oh is very skilled and honest! He was able to tell what was wrong with my girl right away and what needs to be done to further treat her. I will definitely be bring my other pets back here in the future. And have recommended VNVC to my family and friends.

The vet Here Is Amazing had done two surgeries on my rescue  babe Coco she múltiple issues   When I Got Her   And thanks To him she is good with us / He is very thorough  straight to what it is sweet and simple / ooh and i also told my daughter to take he big cane corso here for a check up only since he dnt do surgeries on big dogs and  He didn’t even charge my daughter  for the appt  and the diagnosis  was a good one  /  the best is also the  so affordable   i recommend him 100 percent / Thanks for All You Do  Dr. Oh 🙏🏻
Fit us in without an appointment and  there was little wait. Friendly, caring Vet!
Terrible phone service. Was on hold for more than 20 mins. Until I gave up.

Don’t come for the service. It’s low cost, so that’s valuable for many reasons, but they quickly hang up on you when you call and put you on hold immediately otherwise without waiting for a response. Really frustrating to deal with when your baby is sick and you’ve had to call a thousand times just to get through the busy signal. Vet care in LA has a low bar so I’d still give them an average (3 star) overall rating and keeping costs low is, again, not easy to find in LA, so it’s a balance. But the service here could use some improvement if we’re being honest.
I love this place.This is my number one option. Dr. Oh is thr best
I love this veterinary clinic. They explain everything. Doctor is very attentive and the staff is courteous and friendly. Highly recommend.

The vet may be good but he needs to hire receptionist who is more empathetic and patient with the callers. I was going to bring my cat over but I decided not to and will go somewhere else.
This vet lost my business due to this rude receptionist.

Good: caring and knowledgeable veterinary staff.
